title: Facilities Maintenance Technician - 3rd Shift - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the facilities operations team, you will help build, activate, and maintain some of the world's most technically advanced data centers. You will be able to operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex problems, excel at managing multiple projects at a time, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. As a Facilities Maintenance Technician, you will have the opportunity to utilize your knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop novel solutions at the cutting edge of space technology. You will work with other infrastructure engineers, technicians, and internal customers to support these goals and have the opportunity to drive real global impact, ultimately leading to making life multiplanetary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Collaborate with engineers, managers, and customers to maintain systems in peak operating condition, and to develop/update detailed work instructions for proper equipment preventative maintenance dedicated to ensuring zero unplanned interruption in services to employees and customers.

• Maintain and repair HVAC support equipment on facilities systems including air handlers, chilled water, condenser pumps, cooling towers, valves, filters, etc.

• Perform ductwork modifications, brazing, soldering, evacuation & charging of various refrigerants, water piping, insulation modifications and repairs.

• Assemble, install, repair, and maintain pipes, fittings, heating, water, and drainage systems according to specifications and plumbing codes.

• Perform hands-on shop work and/or on-site disassembly, inspection, reporting, cleaning, troubleshooting, reassembly, and testing of pumps and other mechanical equipment.

• Ensure work and used materials are in compliance with manufacturer specifications.

• Read and interpret schematics for assembly, repair, and reassembly as required.

• Perform failure assessments and day-to-day safety inspections - making recommendations to the supervisor as required.

• Adjust and fabricate mechanical parts using hand and machine tools for mechanical repairs/upgrades.

• Present information on equipment maintenance statuses for all critical facilities as required for internal and external customers.

• Operate a forklift, scissor lift, pallet jack, boom lift, work truck, and overhead crane.

• Written and verbal communication skills, use of MS Outlook and Teams.

• Open, track and resolve electronic work tickets on SpaceX systems.

• Take on additional responsibilities as needed as well as determine and manage priorities with minimal guidance.

• Follow and ensure site compliance with all applicable SpaceXAI, local, state, and federal building codes, regulations, and laws.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent certificate.

• 3+ years of professional experience working with HVAC, plumbing, pneumatic, mechanical, or electrical systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Knowledge in the following areas: HVAC, plumbing, electrical safety, pneumatic principles, tubing, pipefittings, rotating machinery (pumps, air compressors, etc.), and a variety of mechanical fasteners.

• Technical certification, journeyman, or master in HVAC, mechanical, plumbing, or electrical systems.

• Knowle

title: Parcel Point Agent
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position

Vinted Go has opened its very own parcel centres in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Paris and Bordeaux, and the network is expanding. At the centre, Vinted parcels can be collected and dropped-off by customers.
As a parcel centre agent in our new parcel point in Amsterdam, you help customers with their parcels, receive and return parcel bags to drivers, and proactively communicate with colleagues to further improve the centre. 

In this position, you’ll

• Assist customers with dropping off and picking up their parcels.

• Facilitate drivers in the drop-off and pick-up of bags.

• Provide guidance and support to customers experiencing issues with their shipments.

• Maintain a tidy and organized work environment.

• Communicate effectively with other team members to ensure smooth operation.

• Communicate with the representatives of other carriers shipped at the point.

• 7 months fixed term contract.

• 40h per week. 

About you

• Proficiency in English. Dutch is an advantage.

• Excellent customer service skills.

• Ability to represent a brand in a professional and friendly manner.

• Prior experience in a similar role is advantageous.

• Good organisational abilities and attention to detail.

• Open to work on a 6 month fixed-term contract.

• Open to work full-time: 40h per week (including some Saturdays)

Work perks

• 25 days of paid annual leave

• Pension plan with a total contribution of 12%, 8% by the Company and 4% by employee

• Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

• A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

• Company bike leasing scheme

• Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

• Lunch benefit per working day

• Frequent team-building events

• Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

• NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

Working at Vinted

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway - you might still be the perfect match!

The gross salary for this position is: €32,000 per year.

title: Healthcare Receptionist
description:
Position: Healthcare Receptionist
Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)
Full-Time, Remote Work.
Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)
We are looking for a highly organized, compassionate, and detail-oriented Healthcare Receptionist.
The Healthcare Receptionist will be responsible for managing the intake process from the initial point of contact through to the completion of required documentation and coordination of services. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and family information professionally.
The ideal candidate will have experience in healthcare administration.
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients, families, and referral sources.

• Respond to phone calls, emails, and inquiries regarding ABA therapy services.

• Collect and verify patient and family information during the intake process.

• Gather required documentation, including insurance information, referrals, medical records, and other supporting documents.

• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits where required.

• Coordinate with insurance providers, healthcare professionals, referral sources, and internal teams.

• Review referrals and ensure all required information is received before moving cases forward.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records within the organization's systems.

• Schedule assessments, consultations, and other appointments as required.

• Follow up with families and referral sources regarding outstanding documentation or next steps.

• Communicate the intake status clearly to internal teams.

• Identify missing or incorrect information and take appropriate action to resolve issues.

• Ensure all intake activities are completed accurately and within required timelines.

• Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare privacy and data protection requirements.

• Provide a professional, empathetic, and positive experience for families throughout the intake process.

• Assist with administrative tasks related to admissions, referrals, authorizations, and onboarding.

Requirements

• Previous experience in healthcare administration

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.

• Comfortable communicating with parents, caregivers, healthcare providers, and insurance companies.

• Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new systems quickly.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office setup.

• Ability to work US business hours.

title: Senior Engineer I, Software Development - Insight
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead the development of our cloud-based Network Management System (NMS) platform. This role involves building sophisticated web applications and mobile interfaces that enable enterprise customers to monitor, configure, and manage their network infrastructure including switches, routers, and WiFi access points at scale.

Key Responsibilities

- NMS Platform Development: Design and develop scalable web applications for network device management, monitoring, and configuration

- Real-time Dashboard Creation: Build responsive dashboards displaying network topology, device status, performance metrics, and alerting systems

- Device Integration: Develop APIs and interfaces for managing diverse network hardware (switches, routers, access points) from multiple vendors

- Network Visualization: Create interactive network topology maps and device relationship diagrams

- Mobile Management Apps: Build mobile applications for field technicians to configure and troubleshoot network devices remotely

- Performance Monitoring: Implement real-time network performance monitoring, SNMP integration, and telemetry data visualization

- Configuration Management: Develop tools for bulk device configuration, firmware updates, and policy deployment

- Alert Systems: Build intelligent alerting and notification systems for network events and anomalies

- Multi-tenant Architecture: Contribute to secure, scalable multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture

- API Development: Create RESTful APIs for third-party integrations and customer automation workflows

Technical Requirements

- Frontend: Advanced proficiency in React.js/Angular, TypeScript, D3.js for network visualizations, WebSocket for real-time updates

- Backend: Strong experience with Node.js, Python, or Java for building scalable network management services

- Network Protocols: Understanding of SNMP, SSH, Telnet, NETCONF, REST APIs for network device communication

- Database Systems: Experience with time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) for network metrics and traditional databases

- Cloud Platforms: AWS/Azure/GCP experience with focus on networking services, load balancers, and auto-scaling

- Monitoring Tools: Experience with network monitoring protocols, log aggregation, and observability platforms

- Security: Knowledge of network security principles, VPN configurations, and secure device access methods

- DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation

Domain-Specific Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field

- 10-12 years of full-stack development experience with 3+ years in network management or infrastructure software

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, routing protocols, and enterprise networking concepts

- Experience with network device APIs (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Ubiquiti, etc.)

- Knowledge of WiFi standards (802.11), network switching concepts, and routing protocols

- Experience building SaaS platforms for enterprise customers

- Familiarity with network automation tools (Ansible, Puppet) and Infrastructure as Code

Your work will directly shape how our products evolve, including Duck.ai and Assist, and reach millions of users.

3. Creating new distribution channels to help grow our AI related services

- Self-sufficiency on the commercial details - you don’t wait for someone else to draft terms, build financial models, or pressure-test deal structures - you can handle these details on your own while partnering with Legal and Finance.

- Experience with consumer internet or user-facing software business with an understanding of the AI/LLM ecosystem and how AI capabilities are being integrated into consumer products.

- Experience managing a portfolio of complex strategic partner relationships and an understanding of the tradeoffs that come with balancing competing and complementary providers.

- You build trust quickly with internal teams, partners, and stakeholders you've never worked with before. You're collaborative by default and decisive when it counts.

- Located in US or Canada.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist (Paid Ads Specialist)
Full-Time | Remote | Dubai-Based Property Group
About Our Client
OutsourcedIn is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist (Paid Ads Specialist) to join a growing Dubai-based property group operating as part of a larger international investment organisation.
Our client is building a sophisticated digital acquisition capability to support the continued growth of its property business, with a strong focus on generating qualifi ed buyer and investor enquiries through paid digital channels.
This is an opportunity for an experienced performance marketer to take meaningful ownership of the complete paid acquisition journey from the fi rst impression through to the lead entering the CRM.
The successful candidate will be joining the client's team on a full-time, long-term basis and will work remotely while supporting a Dubai-based business.
The Role
As the Digital Marketing Specialist (Paid Ads Specialist), you will be responsible for building, managing and continuously improving the client's digital lead-generation engine.
Meta Ads and Google Ads will sit at the centre of the role.
However, we are not looking for someone who simply launches campaigns and reports on cost per click.
You will take ownership of the entire paid acquisition loop:
Ad Audience Landing Page Lead Capture Tracking CRM Automation Reporting Optimisation
You will be expected to understand how each component aff ects the next.
When a campaign generates traffi c but not enquiries, you need to determine why.
When cost per lead increases, you need to identify what changed and take action.
When Meta reports leads that cannot be reconciled with the CRM, you need to investigate the tracking.
When lead volume increases but lead quality deteriorates, you need to determine whether the problem sits with the audience, off er, creative, messaging, funnel or qualifi cation process.
This is a highly hands-on position for someone who understands both the marketing and technical infrastructure behind successful performance campaigns.
Key Responsibilities
Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

• Product Partnership: Work hand in hand with product and our founders on the shopper roadmap. Retention for an app is a product problem as much as a marketing one; you will bring the user perspective and growth data into what gets built.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of two (growth and lifecycle) from day one, owning the opportunity to hire and expand the team as the business grows.

• Cross-Functional Storytelling: Translate performance into clear narratives for leadership, and keep founders, product, and marketing aligned on where shopper is headed and why.

description: Arrangr | Growth Lead, Expansion & Lifecycle | REMOTE | Fixed-fee project ($12K, milestone-based) + equity tied to ARR results → founding role | https://arrangr.com Arrangr is a scheduling platform with tens of thousands of registered users and hundreds of thousands of people reached through scheduling invitations. Calendly is the incumbent, and it's good. Our thesis: booking links make it efficient to fill your calendar, not productive. Every open slot looks identical, so your best hours go to whoever clicks first. Arrangr schedules by importance. The opportunity: we can see which companies already have several people using Arrangr individually. Each of those is an unmonetized team. You'd build the motion that converts them (in-product surface, sequences, landing page, pilot) and handle the replies it generates: seats, admin rights, security questions. Then reactivate a large dormant base and fix acquisition. The engagement: five milestones over roughly three months, $12K paid on milestone completion, milestones 1 and 2 contracted first. "Done" means shipped, instrumented and measured against a baseline. Equity is a defined grant tied to new ARR booked; hitting the middle tier triggers a founding title. Engineering time is limited, so you ship within existing product surfaces. Right for you if you've run PQL-to-team expansion and reactivation against a base in the tens of thousands. Not for CRO specialists (our volume won't support the testing), paid media buyers, or anyone who wants to manage a team. There is no team. You're it. To apply: no cover letter. Email adams@arrangr.com with three links to things you personally built, one line each on what the numbers did. Plus one answer: we can see which companies have several individual users. How would you turn that into team conversions, and have you run that motion before? I read and reply to every one. - Adam, co-founder/CEO

title: Chief Strategy Officer
description:
Position Overview:
The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The CSO works closely with executive leadership to identify growth opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure alignment across business units. This role requires strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans that deliver measurable results.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Corporate Strategy Development

• Lead the development of short-term and long-term strategic plans aligned with organizational goals.

• Identify growth opportunities, new markets, and competitive positioning strategies.

• Conduct strategic reviews and adjust plans based on market dynamics.

2. Business Planning & Execution

• Translate strategic objectives into actionable business plans and initiatives.

• Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.

• Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

• Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

• Provide insights on emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Support decision-making through data-driven analysis and research.

4. Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

• Lead or support mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.

• Conduct due diligence, financial analysis, and integration planning.

• Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

• Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.

• Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.

• Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.

• Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.

• Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

• Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

• Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.

• Engage with external stakeholders, partners, and industry experts.

• Represent the organization in strategic discussions and forums.

9. Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and mentor strategy, planning, and analytics teams.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking and execution.

• Ensure continuous development of talent and capabilities.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, corporate planning, or senior leadership roles.

• Proven track record in developing and executing successful business strategies.

• Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and business operations.

Key Skills and Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to drive change and organizational transformation.

Performance Metrics:

• Achievement of strategic goals and business growth targets.

• Success of strategic initiatives and transformation programs.

• Market expansion and competitive positioning.

• Efficiency and effectiveness of business operations.

• Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction.

As one of the early members of our security organization, you will play a key role in ensuring our platform meets and exceeds the highest standards for privacy, trust, and regulatory compliance.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and Legal to define compliance requirements, assess platform capabilities, and drive implementation from initial scoping through validation. You will also lead customer assurance efforts, helping customers understand our security architecture and compliance posture while bringing their requirements back into product planning.

Alongside this product focus, you’ll contribute to Baseten’s broader GRC program, including governance, risk management, audits, vendor assessments, and security awareness.

- Product Compliance: Translate regulatory, framework, and customer requirements into clear product requirements and technical controls, partnering with Engineering and Product to build compliance into platform design and development.

- Risk Management: Build and manage the company-wide risk assessment program, identifying, tracking, and mitigating key security and compliance risks.

- Compliance Operations: Support efforts to achieve and maintain compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, HIPAA, FedRAMP and other applicable standards and regulations.

- Audit & Certification Management: Coordinate external audits and certification processes, ensuring evidence collection, control validation, and remediation plans are executed efficiently.

- Third-Party Risk Management: Oversee vendor security assessments and ensure third-party providers meet Baseten’s security and compliance standards.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to embed compliance and risk management into day-to-day operations and technical processes.

- Customer Trust & Assurance: Support customer security questionnaires, due diligence efforts, and documentation requests from prospective and existing clients.

- Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver security and compliance training to ensure company-wide understanding of key policies and responsibilities.

- Continuous Improvement: Stay current on evolving regulatory requirements and lead initiatives to mature our compliance and risk management programs.

REQUIREMENTS

- BS Degree in CS, CE, MIS or equivalent field

- 5+ years of experience in GRC, Security Compliance, or Information Security roles, ideally in a SaaS or cloud-native environment.

- Strong understanding of security frameworks and standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR.

- Proven track record managing compliance audits and certification programs end-to-end.

- Experience working directly with leaders and executives within Enterprise organizations

- Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders to implement compliance and security controls.

- Proven experience driving product compliance

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description: We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile. When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models. The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role. The work Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently. You'll work on two related areas. Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people. AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. We're looking for a Major Account Executive to own and grow a book of strategic enterprise accounts. • Own and grow a book of major/strategic accounts, running the full cycle from qualification through multi-year contract negotiation and close

• Partner with technical presales Solutions Architects to run live technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts that hold up under real scrutiny from technical buyers

• Structure and negotiate enterprise contracts, with a strong bias toward multi-year (3-year) terms

• Build and defend a business case that speaks fluently to both risk reduction (CISO language) and ROI (CFO language) - you need both, not one

• Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene on long-cycle (6-9 month), high-ACV deals

• Prioritize Customer Success for account health, since renewal risk on an account this size is a shared problem, not a handoff

Skills and Qualifications

• 8+ years of closing experience in enterprise cybersecurity/SaaS

• Demonstrated ability to close deals upwards of $1M ARR or more and 6+ month sales cycles

• Track record of navigating security-specific procurement: vendor risk assessments, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 diligence, security questionnaires, and legal review cycles that are more adversarial than typical SaaS procurement

• Comfort being technically challenged in a room - you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own when a CISO pressure-tests your claims

• Experience structuring and closing multi-year contracts, not just annual renewals

• A hunter mentality - use relationships & partnerships to find leverage to close deals

• and this role rewards depth and judgment over sheer volume

Perks

• 100% medical, dental and vision coverage

• Flexible PTO policy

• Annual home office stipend and WeWork access

• Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!

• Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition ?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition ’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. description:

At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

We are seeking a Manager, Business Operations to keep licensing deals moving from term sheet to signature for our Digital Licensing & Partnerships team. Reporting to the VP, Digital Licensing & Partnerships, you'll be the first point of contact for licensees on contract matters and lead our integration into Hasbro's Rightsline instance, working closely with Business Operations, Business Development, Production, Marketing Legal, and Finance across PC/Console and Mobile/Casino categories.

This role combines contract know-how, attention to detail, and cross-functional fluency. You'll work within Legal-approved templates and guidelines, with Legal retaining responsibility for legal advice and approval of non-standard terms. Success will come from shorter contract cycle times, accurate rights data, and a contracting process that scales as the business grows.

This is a hybrid role requiring three days a week in our Renton, WA office.

A Day in the Life as a Manager, Business Operations:
● Serve as the first point of contact for licensees on contract matters, preparing agreements from Legal-approved templates, leading first-pass redlines, and escalating non-standard terms to Legal.
● Lead our integration into Rightsline, partnering with Hasbro's Rightsline system owner on deal and rights record setup, data migration, workflows, and governance.
● Maintain accurate rights and deal records, including term, territory, royalty, and minimum guarantee (MG) data, and partner with Finance on royalty tracking and reporting.
● Track contracts across the deal pipeline with the Director, Business Operations, flagging delays and open issues before they slow deals down.
● Translate business terms into clear contract language alongside Business Development leads, so they spend less time drafting redlines themselves.
● Build playbooks, templates, and clause libraries with Legal, including our Sr Attorney and Paralegal, to speed up future deals and reduce rework.
● Answer contract status and deal-terms questions from BD, Finance, and other partners, routing legal questions to Legal and providing overflow support on NDAs and services agreements.

What You'll Bring:
● 6+ years' experience in Contract administration, licensing operations, or legal support experience, ideally in gaming, media, or entertainment
● Hands-on experience preparing and negotiating licensing agreements, including royalty structures and minimum guarantee (MG) mechanics?
● Working knowledge of IP licensing concepts, including copyright and trademark
● Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience working directly with external partners and across BD, Finance, and Legal
● Organizational skills to manage many contracts at once as priorities shift
● Experience with Rightsline or a similar rights or contract management system a plus
● Familiarity with video game licensing a plus

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Data Analysis Intern - Open The Books
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. About Open the Books
Open the Books is a project of American Transparency, a 501(c)(3) dedicated to educating the public on waste, fraud and abuse and fighting for real-time spending transparency. We believe transparency building block of representative government that makes all our other freedoms possible. We operate the largest private database of public spending in history: 10 billion points of data that includes all federal salaries, line-by-line federal spending, all 50 state “checkbooks,” millions of state-level salaries and pension funds, and spending across more than 17,000 municipalities.
 
We won’t stop until we’ve captured every dime and put it online, in a close to real-time as possible. The database is open to journalists, researchers, activists, public officials - and most importantly - every American taxpayer.
 
About the role
The Data Analysis Intern will help brainstorm and develop creative research projects that leverage Open the Books’ proprietary database to tell unique stories about government waste. Leveraging the nation’s largest repository of public spending, a successful candidate will be excited to consider data comparisons that can move the needle on the conversation about wasteful spending at every level of government (federal, state and local).
 
Candidates with an interest in quantitative research and those who follow the news cycle closely will be a fit with our team of watchdog journalists!

title: Pessoa Analista de BI Junior

description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

- Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

- Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

- Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

- Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

- Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

- Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

- You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

BONUS

- Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

- Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

- Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

title: Performance Tester Internship
description:
Overview: Scalability and Speed Optimization
The Performance Tester is dedicated to ensuring the speed, stability, and scalability of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will plan, design, and execute rigorous load, stress, and endurance tests on the core e-commerce storefront, the performance-critical internal SaaS tools (OMS, WMS, MES), and the emerging AI agent services to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will be the expert in pushing the platform to its limits, guaranteeing optimal user experience even under peak load.

• Test Strategy & Design: Design comprehensive load, stress, and endurance testing strategies for critical systems, focusing on the high-volume e-commerce checkout funnels, payment gateway integrations, and API responsiveness across the modular monolith.

• Execution & Analysis: Execute tests using industry-standard tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and cloud-based load testing services. Analyze results to accurately identify performance bottlenecks in the Node.js/NestJS services, database queries (PostgreSQL/Redis), and infrastructure components.

• Critical Flow Testing: Specifically test the performance and throughput of key supply chain APIs and user flows, including real-time inventory checks (WMS integration), order placement (OMS), and search functionality (Meilisearch).

• Optimization Recommendations: Collaborate closely with the SRE and development teams to translate performance data into clear, actionable optimization strategies for code, database indices, caching (Redis), and infrastructure (auto-scaling).

• CI/CD Integration: Work with the DevSecOps team to integrate performance testing as a mandatory quality gate within the CI/CD pipeline to prevent performance regressions in new deployments.

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess deep experience in performance testing methodology, execution, and analysis:

• Testing Tools: Expert proficiency in JMeter, Gatling, or similar high-scale load generation tools.

• Monitoring & Analysis: Hands-on experience using the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor system metrics, latency, and resource utilization during test execution.

• Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript/Python) for test scenario creation and data generation.

• Backend Knowledge: Strong understanding of database performance tuning (PostgreSQL), caching, and API behavior (REST/JSON).

• Cloud/Infra: Familiarity with cloud-based load testing services and containerized environments (Docker).

AI Agent Focus
You will validate the capacity and latency of our AI services.

• Load Testing AI: Conduct stress and load tests on the AI agent systems, measuring latency and throughput under concurrent user requests, especially concerning the processing power required for LLM interactions (e.g., prompt processing, RAG retrieval).

• Resource Impact: Analyze the impact of AI compute demands on shared infrastructure resources, providing data for cloud capacity planning.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Latency Reduction: Measurable improvements in API response times (e.g., 95th percentile latency) for critical services.

• Throughput: Successful validation of system throughput capabilities against business-defined peak load targets.

• Bottleneck Identification: Accuracy and impact of identified performance bottlenecks and recommended solutions.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Automation QA Lead or Technical Architect, working directly with the SRE and Backend Engineering teams to ensure performance is a core product feature.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including workflow redesign, documentation updates, and automation opportunities.
